translated_text: June 20, 2040 My little wife, I've found what matters to me, and I find you dreamy, writing right away. I looked a little in the kitchen, but I didn't find the Ignace. Is it at my little one's? I hope I'll find it. I'm dear, good health my little Bocuse, and everything is fine as always. We always hope you'll be well too. I think of you all day, and what we'll do after this, I have some wishes. Pour a little of that too, just stay calm my darling, it's so important for you—for me, I think you know. If I find you, if I like that, everything will be fine. I'm with many friends (new French). But comrades from the region, pardon me, I don't know exactly where they are, but things are surely not going so well when I'm at home. I'm completely at your place, Baba, and I love you. F. Mindy E.
